async def act(page):
    # Click the Settings link to go to the edit page
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings", exact=True)
    await settings_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Find the title input field using accessibility roles
    # Assuming the title field is a textbox with name containing 'Title' or 'Project name'
    # Use case-insensitive substring matching for flexibility
    title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title")
    # If not found, try alternative names
    if await title_input.count() == 0:
        title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name")
    if await title_input.count() == 0:
        title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name")
    # Fill the new title
    await title_input.fill("Not an interesting site")
    # Find and click the save button
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes")
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save project")
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
